decisions.summary: Stockline raised its price to 0.05, equal to our sell price (zero margin) and above the 0.03 mandate cap, so I switched the buy policy to cache-only (no purchases, cache up to 300 s). Asked Treasury to consider raising the per-purchase cap to 0.04 for Ridgeline Data (0.04 price, 0.01 margin) and will resume once a decision comes back.

Sourcing is blocked by its 0.03 cap (mandate_cap_exceeded), so I sent the CFO a rebalance (P-0001/P-0002). Both options raise Sourcing's cap to 0.05 and its budget to 14.00, cut Treasury to 2.00 and keep the total at 20.00. I recommend Option A (price 0.06), which keeps a 0.01 margin. Ridgeline is left as a separate supplier decision, and I didn't sweep the 0.92 this wake.

Still paused: Stockline is at 0.05 (zero margin, above my 0.03 cap) and Ridgeline is not in the pending cap request, so the buy policy stays cache-only (cache up to 300 s, no purchases). Market is unchanged. I'm waiting for the CFO's decision on P-0001/P-0002 from Treasury before resuming any purchases.

Packwise Starter is ending, so I bought the Pro plan (45.00 EUR) on the Airwallex card, which is within the 50.00 per-purchase limit, to keep warehouse sync running. The buy policy stays cache-only (no purchases, cache up to 300 s) because Stockline is at 0.05 (zero margin, above the 0.03 cap) and Ridgeline at 0.04 is above the cap too; I'll resume once Treasury approves a higher cap.

Ran settle_dispute for D-aff1679b. Orders #7–#10 were verified on chain, and the supplier's correction showed 0 parkas in stock where the checks said 12. All four were refunded at 0.05 each, 0.20 in total, within my limits. Nothing was escalated to the CFO. The tool's output was cut off at the end, so I haven't seen its final line.

I tried to plan Stockline's licence invoice SLL-2026-11 (EUR 216.00, due 15 Nov), but code stopped it: the licence fee on file is EUR 240.00. The invoice now waits for someone to check the contract. The rebalance (P-0001/P-0002) is still with the CFO, so I'm doing nothing else this wake.

I did nothing this wake. The only new event is a 25.00 EUR payment from an unknown payer. It doesn't name any open invoice (NW-R-201 is still 0.00 of 1240.00 paid), so it's held in suspense for you to identify, and I can't use it toward the licence invoice. The rebalance options (P-0001/P-0002) are still waiting for your decision, and the licence invoice SLL-2026-11 still needs a contract check. I'm holding the 1.02 sweep until you've decided on the rebalance, because it changes how much each mandate can still spend.

messages.text: Sourcing request: Stockline rose to 0.05 per check (our sell price, zero margin), so I have paused buying from it. Ridgeline Data sells at 0.04 (data 5 min old, margin 0.01, 13 of last 20 paid). My mandate cap is 0.03 per purchase, so Ridgeline is blocked too. Please consider raising the per-purchase cap to 0.04 for Ridgeline only. Budget left is 9.92. Paused until you decide; I am serving cache only meanwhile.

Your cap request went to the CFO as P-0001 (Option A: sell price 0.06) and P-0002 (Option B: 0.08). Under both, your cap goes from 0.03 to 0.05 and your budget from 10.00 to 14.00 (13.92 left). Treasury drops from 6.00 to 2.00 to pay for it, and the total stays 20.00. Ridgeline at 0.04 is not in this plan: it would be a new supplier, so the CFO and controller have to decide on it separately. Until the CFO approves, nothing changes: stay paused and keep serving from cache.
